summary: Changed-files tree built from a path list with M, A and D markers; folders count their changes and arrow keys follow the tree pattern.

attributes.name: paths
attributes.description: Comma-separated file paths, each optionally followed by `:M` (modified), `:A` (added) or `:D` (deleted); other status letters are ignored. Folders come from the `/` segments. Observed: a change rebuilds the tree and keeps expanded folders and the selection where they still exist.

events.name: select
events.description: Fires when the user selects a row by click or keyboard, including each arrow-key move. `file` is `false` for folders.

properties.name: entries
properties.description: The parsed `paths`; `st` is `M`, `A`, `D` or an empty string. Entries without a path are skipped.

keyboard.action: Move to and select the next or previous row.
Expand a closed folder; on an open folder, move to its first child.
Collapse an open folder; otherwise move to the parent folder.
Move to and select the first or last row.
Select the row; on a folder, also expand or collapse it.

accessibility: Rows sit in a `role="tree"` named by the heading (for example `8 files changed`) as `role="treeitem"` with `aria-level`, `aria-posinset`, `aria-setsize`, `aria-selected` and, on folders, `aria-expanded`.
Focus uses a roving `tabindex`: only the selected row is in the tab order.
Status letters have a `title` of Modified, Added or Deleted, and deleted files are struck through.
Changed only is a toggle button with `aria-pressed`.
Icons, guide lines and the selection highlight are drawn on an `aria-hidden` canvas.
motion: With reduced motion, new rows appear without sliding in or the scan line, and the selection highlight jumps instead of springing.
notes: Folders that contain changes start expanded, and the first changed file is selected without firing `select`.
Changed only hides unchanged files and folders without changes. The header shows the number of changed files.
Siblings sort folders first, then by name.

data.note: Pass your changed files as `paths` (`path:M`, `:A` or `:D`). Without it a demo path list is shown.
